title: Musing Moonmote
statement: A palm-sized, moon-jelly-like drifter with a lantern-bright heart, the Musing Moonmote gathers specks of light and arranges them into constellations before absentmindedly eating one. Its deep-indigo tank holds only a pale stone arch and ribbons of glass-green eelgrass, so every soft pulse feels like a thought becoming visible.
